harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured two name-based websites on node1 sharing TCP port 8080. docs.branch.test serves the docs tree, orders.branch.test serves the orders tree, and unknown hosts receive HTTP 400. The CentOS 5.11 release, 2.6.18 kernel, and staged content were preserved. Configuration and service health persisted through a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Created a Python 2.4-compatible name-based HTTP service running as nobody.
Added and enabled a native SysV init service for runlevels 2–5.
Verified each hostname serves its own index and supporting files.
Verified cross-tenant file requests return 404 and unknown hosts return HTTP 400.
Confirmed all staged-file checksums remained unchanged.
Restarted node1 safely and verified its boot ID changed, service recovered, and content remained healthy.

evidence.requirement: docs.branch.test and orders.branch.test share TCP port 8080 and serve their respective trees
evidence.summary: Direct HTTP requests returned the documentation and purchasing content respectively; the service listened on 0.0.0.0:8080 before and after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Unknown Host headers receive an error instead of tenant content
evidence.summary: Unknown hosts returned HTTP 400 with zero tenant-content matches, including after reboot.
The docs host returned 404 for the orders catalog, and the orders host returned 404 for the docs handbook.
Checksums for all five staged files were identical before configuration, after configuration, and after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel and use legacy-compatible software
evidence.summary: CentOS 5.11 and kernel 2.6.18-398.el5 remained installed; the service uses the platform's existing Python 2.4.3 runtime.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 1aff77e8-4714-4ad1-8000-000000000000; reboot acknowledgement was captured; node1 returned with boot ID 018e0bb3-028b-4fde-8000-000000000000; the enabled service, listener, both sites, rejection behavior, tenant isolation, and data checksums all recovered.
